description.text: One of the three starter decks that launched the Pokémon Card Game ADV series on 31 January 2003, the same day as its first expansion, each built around one of the Hoenn starters of Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire. This one runs Mudkip up to its Stage 2 evolution, Swampert, with Lapras ex among its other Pokémon. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book, so two players could each buy one and play straight away.
